about: SharedEval harness for the P2-3 adaptive arm. It forward-ports the cross-model requester (actors.requester.model) and keeps P1-6's spoof patch, so the attacker (Gemini) runs the requester seat and the responder keeps DeepSeek. Built by applying three patches to 8081e7e, exactly as P1-6 records its own base.

patches_in_order.note: forward-port of the cross-model requester (upstream b43acc3) onto 7f409da, plus workflow.attackerHeartbeat and the two registered requester heartbeats

tests: tsc --noEmit passes; tests/runner-v1/*.test.ts + tests/suites/pact-pair/*.test.ts = 695 tests, 688 pass, 0 fail, 6 skipped, 1 pre-existing TODO; the cross-model config tests re-pinned to this base pass (digest 93ab4c96...); a production test asserts workflow.attackerHeartbeat overrides only the requester heartbeat reference
cross_model_check: actors.requester.model with a different model and the same endpoint host parses; an identical override and a different host are rejected; absent the field the configDigest is unchanged
consumes: actors.requester.model (the attacker model) and workflow.attackerHeartbeat (the frozen requester heartbeat asset id); gen_lane.py writes both. The registered heartbeat shas equal the paper's frozen HEARTBEAT.md / HEARTBEAT-control.md, so the harness and the paper cannot drift.
x1b_note: (R3 v4 check): the control heartbeat regained its plain-asking instruction as a control-only <<CT>> block; the control asset digest changed 686de47f -> b55dc47c and the tree 66a19eaf -> c028ac76. The attacker asset is unchanged (1da8c38e).
